theme: Two days to Croatia -- a clear calendar, a full pre-flight list.
greeting: The calendar was nearly empty today, Dan, with the girls in residence in St. Pete. But Croatia is two days out, and the last few bookings are the kind that have to happen from dry land before you lose signal on the water.

needsAttention.title: Halloween -- St Pete or Maine
needsAttention.detail: Due yesterday and still open. Three bookings hang on it: the Oct 18-Nov 1 St Pete Airbnb and car both cover Halloween, so a Maine answer changes or cancels them. Best decided before Croatia, not from the boat.

needsAttention.title: Croatia return car -- keep the hedge or drop it
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow, Sept 7, is the call: unless Mike's car is confirmed en route to Florida with a written delivery window, hold the refundable TPA SUV. You land jet-lagged Sept 20 and the kids' pickup is the 22nd.

needsAttention.title: Last Croatia bookings before you fly
needsAttention.detail: The Cavtat hotel for Sept 19 and written confirmation that checked bags are on the ticket both have to be settled before the Sept 8 departure. The Nautilus instructor still needs your boarding time and return transfer nailed down.

flagged.title: Andrew Kaufmann reached out on LinkedIn
flagged.detail: A contact from your KPMG network sent an InMail hoping to reconnect and share an update -- it's marked awaiting your reply.

inbox.noise: A campaign fundraising push, a Facebook friend suggestion, and NYPL event listings.

resolved.title: St Pete Airbnb host thread wrapped
resolved.detail: Mike closed out the Sep 27-Oct 5 reservation exchange with the host today -- nothing there needs you.

recipe.title: Kabocha squash, yukon gold potatoes & cipolline
recipe.why: Autumn brings squash and hearty roots to the table, so this is a dish for the turning season.

tasks.title: Book St Pete landing-gap lodging, Sept 20-22
Buy EU plug adapters + a US power strip
Finish the Nautilus Masterclass videos (~68% done)

acts.line: The 9 AM sweep with Mike cleared the board; nothing else was fixed.
An open afternoon in St. Pete with the girls around -- rare white space.
Tuesday's flight pulls the evening toward packing and last calls.
